verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a ZeroTrace Mode under which it does not store search parameters, files, or data after a search completes. That would indirectly keep user data out of any training pipeline. Without ZeroTrace, searches are kept in a temporary 1-hour cache and a Searches Archive. The pack contains no explicit statement about AI-training use of customer data or an opt-out from it. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or AI-training opt-out policy, clarity on which plans include ZeroTrace, and independent corroboration that ZeroTrace works as described.
